decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the 25 products, I narrowed my focus to dedicated backpacks and packs. Within my consideration set, the G4Free Tactical Shoulder Backpack (prod_backpacks_050) offered the best combination of capacity (35L), positive customer feedback (4.6 stars), and price ($28.99). The Explorer Day Pack (prod_backpacks_171) was a strong contender but significantly more expensive at $42.12. The specialized packs like the SUNLUG Cooler Backpack (prod_backpacks_048) and the NICGID Sling (prod_backpacks_140) were interesting but less versatile than the G4Free, which received high praise for its durability and roominess.
